metadata.scientific_disclaimer: SCIENTIFIC NOTICE: Priority scores represent deterministic multi-criteria decision indices for emergency logistics, computed strictly from verified satellite observations (Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR, NASA VIIRS Black Marble VNP46A2), DEM topography, and OSM topological road networks. These scores quantify vulnerability, infrastructure severance, and accessibility impedance; they DO NOT represent confirmed casualties, localized ground-truth emergencies, or hydraulic forecasts. Missing satellite observations (such as cloud obstruction) are never fabricated as power outages and are penalized in the confidence index.
